Senior Full-Stack Engineer, remote within the EU.

Hands-on role building our React and TypeScript web app and the Node.js APIs behind it. You will model data in PostgreSQL and keep our automated test suite trustworthy.

Essential: hands-on React and TypeScript front-end development; Node.js API development.
Preferred: PostgreSQL data modelling; automated end-to-end testing.

No direct reports.
